kapak.alt: Why does it rarely exceed 60 dB?

youtube.baslik: Why does conductive hearing loss rarely exceed 60 dB? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Conductive hearing loss usually does not exceed about 60 dB, because louder sounds reach the cochlea through the skull anyway. So a very severe loss is not expected to be explained by a conductive component alone.
youtube.kapanis_metni: Follow AIHEAR Audiology Academy for more quick facts.

bilgiler: A problem in the outer or middle ear causes conductive loss.
